response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM `order` WHERE amount > 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall_avg FROM per) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amt AS average_amount, p.avg_amt - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amt > o.overall_avg
